Name: Gifts from Evelyn - A Garden of Memories
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
Deepen your bond with Pelican Town's sweetest grandmother! As your friendship with Evelyn grows, receive heartwarming weekly letters containing a thoughtful progression of custom-tailored gifts. Watch your farm bloom with assorted flower seeds, decorate your home with exclusive seasonal botanical arrangements, and enjoy comforting homemade treats straight from her oven.
